item_short_desc: Rothco’s 10 x 50MM Binoculars provide excellent magnification and a wide field of view, making them perfect for the great outdoors. Whether you're bird watching, hiking, or attending a sports event, these outdoor binoculars deliver sharp and clear imagery with their 50 MM objective lens. The 10X magnification and 122M (367 foot) field of view allow you to see distant objects with incredible detail. The 5MM exit pupil ensures bright images even in low light conditions, while the 12.7MM eye relief provides comfortable viewing.
description: Rothco’s 10 x 50MM Binoculars provide excellent magnification and a wide field of view, making them perfect for the great outdoors. Whether you're bird watching, hiking, or attending a sports event, these outdoor binoculars deliver sharp and clear imagery with their 50 MM objective lens. The 10X magnification and 122M (367 foot) field of view allow you to see distant objects with incredible detail. The 5MM exit pupil ensures bright images even in low light conditions, while the 12.7MM eye relief provides comfortable viewing for extended periods. These hunting binoculars come with a convenient carrying case for easy storage and transportation, ensuring you’re always ready for your next adventure.
